metadata.title: आदिवासी बसंत उत्सव यानि सरहुल या बाह परब । Adivasi Festival of Flowers ।Sarhul Festival
metadata.description:
Sarhul festival is one of the biggest festivals of Adivasis of North and Central India, especially in the states of Jharkhand, Odisha and West Bengal.

But this year the celebrations were muted due to the Covid pandemic. Sarhul was celebrated within families this year. But the Main Bhi Bharat team was lucky to be part of the festivities in a small tribal village in Odisha.

#Odisha #Sarhul_Festival #Main_Bhi_Bharat
